name: Gao Leng Shi Zi De Zhang Xin Chong
overview: Framed by her fiancé and stripped of her family and status, Huang Ying is forced into the Music Bureau before being taken in by Li Jingtian, the heir to a prince’s household. Determined to save her parents and clear her father’s name, she carefully earns his trust and gradually captures his heart—but find herself torn apart by class and forbidden love.
